newsitem.title: UK: UK manufacturing pay awards up in 3 mths to April.
newsitem.headline: UK manufacturing pay awards up in 3 mths to April.

text.p: Pay awards in Britain's manufacturing sector edged up slightly in the three months to April, but were still lower than in the same period last year, the Confederation of British Industry (CBI) said on Monday.

Its Pay Databank Survey showed pay awards averaged 3.3 percent in the three months to April, up from 3.2 percent in the three months to March, but lower than the 3.5 percent average seen in the three months to April 1996.

The CBI said 37 percent of manufacturers said their inability to increase prices was keeping down pay awards, while 25 percent of firms identified low profits as important and 18 percent said the low rise in the cost of living was a factor.
In the services sector, pay awards fell slightly in the period, averaging 3.5 percent compared with 3.6 percent in the three months to March.
